summary: Most round 1 fixes hold on the code: the readers of row 15 return the fields, the logo and label no longer overlap in landscape, the font rule reads var(--title-chars), the spec text agrees, and the logo attributes are 48. One new Blocker remains: commit 770fadd47 deleted readBrandElements, brandToneSummary, readBrandBanner, and the brand constants from look-phase2-browser-gate.sh, but rows 16, 17, and 18 still call them. These rows raise a ReferenceError at HEAD, and the --self-test hides this because it calls only verdict functions. Two Major items follow: the band plaque keeps a fixed 44 px font that defeats the fitted rule and no row measures it, and the two-tone focus ring loses its brown ring to a more specific box-shadow rule on every week-page button. No browser, build, or test run was possible: the shell was denied for most calls, so the vitest counts are not re-verified. Static review only.
blocking_findings: F9 [Blocker] review-a: A2-F1 look-phase2-browser-gate.sh calls readBrandElements (lines in rows 16 and 18), brandToneSummary (rows 16 and 18), and readBrandBanner (row 17, lines 2319 and 2353) but defines none of them at HEAD. Rationale: commit 770fadd47 removed the Row 16 helper block (BRAND_FAMILIES, readBrandElements, isRgbOf, BRAND_BLUE, BRAND_AMBER, BRAND_BROWN, brandToneSummary) and the readBrandBanner function while it added blueInkVerdict and readBlueInk (git diff 5c386d9cd..4b9033cec; the old file at 5c386d9cd line 2313 holds 'async function readBrandBanner'). Row 16 and row 17 now print 'the row raises an error', and each page of row 18 fails with the same error, so FAIL=0 (P2b.3 item 5 and P2b.4) cannot be reached and the P-2 proof (blue_text_or_ground=0) never runs. The --self-test calls verdict functions only and still passes 74 of 74, so the Red evidence line 'row 16 counts blue_text_or_ground ... --self-test exit 0' in plan 2b.1 r3 is true for the verdicts and false for the rows (A5). It is not a vacuous pass (A4): the rows fail closed. Evidence: grep for 'function readBrandElements|brandToneSummary|readBrandBanner' in apps and packages returns no definition; the gate-r3 log at 5c386d9cd shows rows 16 and 17 PASS because the helpers still existed then. Proposal: FIX by Red (restore the three helpers and constants from 5c386d9cd, keep readBlueInk, and add a self-test or static check that every helper that a row calls has a definition, for example a node --check plus a ReferenceError probe of the script body with stubbed page objects).
nonblocking_findings: F10 [Major] review-a: A2-F2 The band plaque keeps a fixed font size of 44 px (apps/storytime/app/look.css:211-216, 'header[data-hero="band"] > h1 { font-size: 44px; }'), so it overrides the fitted clamp of the base rule (look.css:197) for the book and decodable pages, and the comment at look.css:210 says 'keeps the floor font at 24 px'. Rationale: AC-4.6 says the font follows the plaque width from the title length and that each shipped title (6 to 13 characters) takes one line. With the Red width model of 0.68 em per character, a title of 12 or more characters at 44 px is wider than the 334 px text width of a 390 px screen, so 'Is It a Ball?' and 'Unit 1 Review' may wrap on the band. A second line would make the plaque 110 px high, anchored 28 px below a 96 px hero, so its top edge would reach 14 px and cover the logo (top 8 px, 48 px high) in breach of AC-4.3. No test sees this: row 17 reads only the home view (cover variant, /st/3/<week>), the F-2b unit case reads only the first plaque rule (the base rule), and the landscape block (look.css:773-783) re-fits the font. Not measured in a browser. Proposal: FIX by Green (remove the band font-size line or give it the fitted clamp with the band floor, and correct the comment); FIX by Red (add a band row that opens the book or decodable view for the eight titles and reads line_count and logo overlap, and let F-2b read every plaque rule outside the media block).

F11 [Major] review-a: A2-F3 The two-tone focus ring (Review C finding C-F1) is incomplete in the cascade. look.css:42-47 sets 'outline: 3px solid #fff' and a brown 'box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px var(--st-brown)' at the specificity of 'button:focus-visible' (0,1,1), but 'main[data-place] button' (look.css:405-420, specificity 0,1,2) and the later button rules (look.css:433-468) set their own box-shadow, so the brown ring never paints on the week-page buttons. Only the white outline stays, and white on cream #fffaf0 or on amber #fcd34d is about 1.04:1 and 1.4:1. The tile links (look.css:317-330) lose the shadow in the same way. Rationale: the C-F1 unit case (look-brand-chrome.test.ts:1071-1113) reads the declared tones of the one focus rule and not the computed result, so it passes. Proposal: FIX by Green (draw the second tone with an outline or an !important shadow, or raise the specificity of the focus rule, and keep the button shadow in the ring list); FIX by Red (a case that reads the effective box-shadow of 'main[data-place] button:focus-visible' and a browser row that reads the computed ring on one cream-fill button). Not measured in a browser.

F12 [Nit] review-a: A2-F4 The verdicts of row 18 for the 403 page and the 404 view are thin. brandForbiddenVerdict (look-phase2-browser-gate.sh:401-404) asserts 0 chrome pairs and 0 buttons and does not read the response status, so a blank page or a redirect that renders no button also passes (A4 type: absence is the proof). brandNotFoundVerdict (406-409) requires one console error, but it reads no chrome pair, so the not-found view, which this phase changed, has no live tone proof. Proposal: FIX by Red (add status 403 to the forbidden verdict and a brand pair floor to the not-found verdict, with a self-test mutant for each).

F13 [Nit] review-a: A2-F5 Stale or wrong text after the remediation. packages/read-along/lib/highlight.ts:12 says white on brown #92400e measures 8.6:1; the WCAG 2 value is about 7.1:1 (the pair still passes 4.5:1, and highlight-contrast.test.ts computes the real ratio). look.css:4 names the game bar and the crest, look.css:80 says 'navy vignette', look.css:360 says 'navy check', and done-mark.tsx:5 says 'navy check' (the vignette is brown now). The plan 2b.1 r3 text lists rows that cannot run (see F9). Proposal: FIX by Green (correct the five comments); the plan text follows the F9 fix.

A-F2 code closed, proof blocked by F9: row 18 signs the teacher account in (2400-2403, signIn at 609-627, makeContext session 'teacher' at 646), the teacher pages use brandTeacherVerdict without the tap floor (393-399, 2444-2450), the 403 link is treated as non-chrome (401-404), and the 404 view allows exactly one 404 console error (406-409, 2427). A-F3 closed: look.css:716-783 (landscape): the label sits at left 72 px, top 18 px, translate none; the logo sits at left 16 px, 48 px wide (look.css:155-171), so it ends at 64 px and leaves 8 px; the plaque font comes from var(--title-chars) in the media block (look.css:782) and frame.tsx:72 sets no inline font size. Case F-3b (look-brand-chrome.test.ts:1006-1069) reads media blocks and the merged label and logo values. The band font stays open as F10.

A-F4 closed for the base rule: look.css:195-197 reads var(--title-chars) with line-height 1.25 (199) and padding '0 16px' (193); F-2b (look-brand-chrome.test.ts:968-1004) asserts the var in font-size, no inline font size in frame.tsx, line-height 1.25, and zero vertical padding. frame.tsx:72 sets only the custom property, from title.length (a number): safe. look.css:195 and 782 both read it, so the property is no longer dead.
A-F5 code closed, proof blocked by F9: TITLE_WEEKS lists 8 titles (gate:421-430) and row 17 loops 8 x 2 locales (2312-2337); the gate-r3 log at 5c386d9cd shows 16 cases PASS with the helper present.

A-F6 closed: spec.md AC-4.6 (line 211) says the font follows the plaque width from the title length and lists the 0.76 to 0.84 per-line rule; AC-4.3 holds logo_title_overlap_px=0; new AC-4.9 and requirement (e) exist.
A-F7 accepted as pre-existing (disposition: Phase 3); not re-routed.
A-F8 closed: frame.tsx:71 renders width={48} height={48}.
C-F2 closed: look.css:440-442 and 463-469 use #fde68a with a brown label (about 5.7:1 by my computation); case C-F2 (look-brand-chrome.test.ts:1115-1149). C-F1 stays open as F11. C-F3 accepted.

P-1 closed on code: packages/read-along/lib/highlight.ts:13 gives 'bg-[#92400e] text-white dark:bg-[#fcd34d] dark:text-[#92400e]'; highlight-contrast.test.ts:66-87 computes white on brown (about 7.1:1) and brown on amber (about 4.9:1), and the blue check is a class match. git diff of packages/read-along/hooks, apps/storytime/lib/highlight-windows.ts, and apps/storytime/app/look/places over 3480f904c509dc2d66fa827dba73df95b3768c65..4b9033cec prints nothing (AC-4.7). The package diff also holds read-along-passage.tsx: the word focus ring takes ring-[#92400e] and ring-offset-[#fffaf0] (2 lines), which AC-4.7 does not forbid.

P-2 closed on code: look.css:20-47 defines --st-amber, --st-brown, --st-ink #3b1d0a, and --st-ink-soft #6b3a14; no rule in look.css or the app files names --sq-navy, --sq-ink, --sq-ink-soft, --sq-blue, --sq-blue-top, --sq-blue-dark, --sq-ice, --sq-plaque, --sq-gold, --sq-gold-top, --sq-gold-soft, or --sq-gold-img (grep of var(--sq-*) lists only --sq-cream, --sq-display, --sq-shadow, --sq-chip-text, which are all defined at :root). The removed names appear only in look-brand-chrome.test.ts as forbidden-token lists (lines 26-30, 1156-1162, 1250-1253), which is intended. No other app imports packages/read-along/lib/highlight (primary-advantage keeps its own audit-highlight.ts), so the brown word has no blast radius outside Storytime.
Callers: Frame has one consumer (app/[locale]/st/[level]/[week]/page.tsx); frame.tsx exports the same Frame and FrameProps, so no caller is broken by the new custom property.

A3: the new count assertions use labeled integers (blue_chrome_classes=, neutral_chrome_classes=, logo_bands_measured=, logo_h_px_min=, files_scanned=, class_sites_scanned=). No bare-digit count found. A4: row 15 verdict cannot pass on a missing logo or label; the new brand rows fail closed when a helper is missing (F9), but the forbidden verdict passes on a blank page (F12). A7: the landscape and the C-F1 cases read CSS declarations and not computed results (F10, F11).

A5: plan 2b.1 r3 says the gate counts blue_text_or_ground on the five child screens and that --self-test exits 0 with 74 of 74. The second claim is true for the verdicts, and the first claim is false for the rows because the helpers are missing (F9). The 2b.4 text of r2 reports FAIL rows truthfully. I did not re-count 74 mutants and did not re-run vitest.

The r4 gate run in progress will show rows 16, 17, and 18 failing with 'the row raises an error' unless the log was started from a different script copy; check the first lines of the r4 log for 'ReferenceError'.
